verdict.rationale: Zep's own docs describe Graphiti, its open-source temporal knowledge graph framework, as providing a bi-temporal model and fact invalidation. Graphiti's GitHub also says its context graphs track how facts change over time. That is first-party support for temporal fact validity, but the evidence names the capability without showing how it works, and none of it ties temporal validity to the hosted Zep Context Graph. missing for 10: documented valid/invalid timestamp fields on facts or edges, how retrieval separates current from outdated facts, explicit confirmation that hosted Zep Context Graphs (not only Graphiti) expose temporal validity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can track when facts became valid or invalid (temporal reasoning) so the memory distinguishes current from outdated information
